title: Neural Consciousness Lamp
description: A surreal painting depicts a transparent glass lamp containing a glowing yellow, blue, and pink branching neural network resembling a tree or brain synapses. In the background, a translucent human silhouette in profile has a magenta serpentine form emerging from its mouth, surrounded by colorful concentric circles and abstract energy patterns.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of a large transparent glass lamp with a glowing branching neural tree inside in bright yellow, cyan, and magenta, standing on a black base. Behind it is a translucent human silhouette in profile with a magenta wavy form flowing from its mouth, set against a vibrant abstract background of swirling concentric circles and energy auras in blue, pink, green and purple, mystical and psychedelic atmosphere.
